ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with approximately 30-35% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated on lateral tips and scattered mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity (white) regions localized at the distal tips of both lobes. Extensive micro-mottling and speckled high-intensity pixels distributed across the central and medial fluke surface. Distinct dark linear features bisecting the white patches on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 65-75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire horizontal boundary. Continuous sequence of sharp peaks and shallow valleys with varied pixel amplitudes, particularly pronounced on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to the leading edges, extending from the central peduncle insertion point to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparsely distributed circular high-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily on the right lobe and near the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant density of unaligned linear pixel disruptions. Multiple parallel dark-toned rake marks are visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally. Shorter, lighter horizontal abrasions are detected across the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (linear scarring) across the right ventral surface. The trailing edge exhibits significant irregular topography suggestive of cumulative physical wear or minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast white terminal tips that create a sharp geometric break against the dark primary fluke body.
